headline: Marketing Communications | Content & Website Strategy | Team Leadership
headline_rationale: Pave needs communications, brand content, website ownership, team coordination and measurement. Source supports content strategy, creative, websites, leadership and analytics; do not claim media relations/crisis PR history. Job text includes SLC hybrid hub; current eligibility safeguards remain in force.
summary: Marketing leader experienced in connecting content, websites and cross-functional execution with measurable business priorities. Developed personalized content across blogs, mail, email and websites, created marketing concepts through graphic design and animation, and led an eight-person e-commerce team. Directed marketing work with sales, product, operations and IT partners, while evaluating agencies and building leadership KPI reporting. Technical website and analytics experience adds practical depth for coordinating creative work, improving digital experiences and communicating clear recommendations.
factual_review: Read exact Pave Marketing Communications Lead posting including four-day hybrid culture and Salt Lake City hub. Supported E114/E109/E093/E060/E011/E096/E001/E113/E044. No invented earned-media reach, PR crisis response, executive media coaching, compensation-tech expertise or customer-story portfolio.
tools_rationale: Supported website, content-adjacent, analytical and CRM tooling; no unverified PR platform expertise.
